note: Fusion layer: GT-Analyst top-down (branch-weighted sector scores from data/timelines.json: contained 0.25, flip-b 0.60 (7/14 branch flip), succession 0.10, capitulation 0.05) x TradingAgents bottom-up (per-ticker debate verdicts recorded via tools/record_ta.py). Scores -1..+1. Fused = 0.5*topdown + 0.5*bottomup when both exist; agreement amplifies conviction (extremizing #5 applies ONLY because the two engines use independent evidence: macro branches vs ticker fundamentals). CONFLICT rows are the highest-information trades: one engine is wrong.
